note.simple: It gets a coloured tag so the operator knows which street and which house it came from.
note.technical: Double-tagged (Q-in-Q): an S-VLAN per cabinet, a C-VLAN per customer, towards the BNG.

sdei.name: S-DEI
sdei.about: May be dropped first when busy.

svid.about: The outer tag: which street cabinet it came through.

cdei.name: C-DEI
cdei.about: May be dropped first when busy.

cvid.about: The inner tag: which customer line. The BNG knows your subscription by it.
